heading: Dalmatia — sixty parishes, three hundred and forty-three volumes
lead: The Dalmatian lines run through **Omiš**, **Split**, **Trogir and Seget**, **Imotski**, **Zadar** and **Dubrovnik**. These are the filmed registers of those parishes and of the ring each of them married into, walked through the same image waypoints as Istria. **Three hundred and forty-three volumes, and every one of them returned a link** — nothing failed.
